name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, run-it-yourself replacement for paid voice-cloning services like ElevenLabs — clone a voice, dub a video into another language, or turn text into narration, all on your own computer.
buyer: An audiobook publisher, video localization studio, or podcast producer who's currently paying per-minute fees to a cloud voice service and wants to cut that cost while keeping voice recordings private.
business_use_cases: A small audiobook publisher narrates and produces books in-house using cloned narrator voices instead of hiring voice actors or paying per-minute cloud TTS fees.
A video agency dubs client marketing videos into multiple languages for international launches without sending footage or voice data to a third-party cloud service.
A course creator turns written lesson scripts into natural-sounding narrated videos in several languages to reach international students.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a dubbing/localization service to YouTubers and course creators who want their content in multiple languages without hiring voice actors per language.
Run a self-hosted 'audiobook production' shop for independent authors, charging per finished audiobook.
Sell a managed, privacy-guaranteed voice-cloning subscription to businesses (e.g. call centers, e-learning companies) that can't send voice data to third-party clouds.

steal_this: Clone your own voice, dub one of your existing videos into two other languages this weekend, and post it as a before/after demo to attract localization clients.
